svg.text: F1 Tyre-Aware Pit Stop Engine: data pipeline
How a lap travels from the timing source to the tables the models and the dashboard read. Counts are from the full run on real data (5 October 2026).
One race at a time; a saved
one file per race, one row per
Who and when: Driver, Team, Year, Round, EventName, LapNumber
Time: LapTime_s, Time_s (session clock), PitInTime_s, PitOutTime_s
Race state: Position, TrackStatus (safety car, flags)

lap are copies: the step stops
A car gets faster as fuel burns.

Gap to the car ahead, and
Windows of the last 10 laps of
Read once the models are frozen
Every step reads the previous step's file and writes its own, so any step can be rerun alone and the files show what each step did.
Nothing learned from validation or test seasons flows back: fuel slopes, scaling and Stage 1 models come from training races only.
All settings (seasons, thresholds, rule-forced races) are in configs/default.yaml. Raw and processed data are rebuilt by the pipeline and not committed.
